findings.summary: Floating absolute/relative tolerance can equate distinct embedded integer bit patterns; old unpack case ignored the actual pack output. findings.repair: Keep exact byte copies behind the unchanged public readonly five-number tuple. Private N-API uses typed packed buffers in both directions; WASM copies bytes into/out of its heap. The existing extensible RPC codec has a descriptor-specific typed tag. Both harnesses compare time bounds plus all six extracted signed integer fields and can retain actual packed output for later actual unpack. Literal all-eight-field assertions and a controlled one-bit defect establish assertion sensitivity. Ordinary numerical arrays retain their existing RPC representation.
